articles.standfirst: Pittsburgh continue their preparation for the 2026 - 2027 season
articles.summary: Pittsburgh continue their preparation for the 2026 - 2027 season
articles.body:
The third week of the NFL preseason continues, and the Steelers are still fine-tuning pieces before the real action begins . When the Pittsburgh Steelers host the New York Jets, neither team will be playing to win a title, but rather to address roster questions, evaluate the players fighting for a spot on the roster, and give rhythm to the units that are still taking shape.

Without a doubt, this is August American football, with all the uncertainty and value opportunities for each team preparing for the 2026-2027 NFL season

How are the Steelers and Jets coming into their preseason matchup?

We are facing a preseason matchup, not a regular-season game, and that completely changes how it should be analyzed. In these contests, starters usually see limited action —sometimes just one offensive series, sometimes none at all—while the bulk of the minutes falls to backups, rookies, and players on the roster bubble.

The result matters less than the rotations, and that is why it is advisable to treat each betting line with caution: the depth of the bench and the coaching staff's decisions about who plays and how much carry more weight than any historical hierarchy between the franchises.

For the Steelers , playing at home always adds a sense of pride , although in the preseason the home-field advantage fades. For the Jets, it is another stop on the August tour to fine-tune details before the official kickoff. Both arrive with the same goal: to come out healthy and with answers.

Steelers - Jets: What time do they play and where can you watch the game live?

The kickoff of the Steelers - Jets matchup is scheduled for this Friday, August 21, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time . In the rest of the United States, the game's start times will be:

The setting for the matchup between Pittsburgh and New York will be Acrisure Stadium, in the city of Pittsburgh, United States, a venue with a capacity of 68,400 spectators. The Steelers are the home team in a game corresponding to the 2026 NFL preseason .

Coverage of this game and the entire NFL around the world will be available through NFL Game Pass International via DAZN. For the United States, you can watch the live broadcast on NFL Network and WCBS.

How is the betting market looking in the preseason and for the Steelers - Jets game?

At the moment there are no published lines for this matchup—the betting market usually opens these August games with little advance notice and low depth—, so instead of quoting prices that do not exist, it is worth explaining how these matchups have historically behaved and what to look for when the odds appear.

The first rule in preseason: the moneyline is a coin flip on steroids. Without established starters for the full 60 minutes, favoritism is built more on roster depth and on which backup quarterback gets more minutes than on the franchise name.

It is advisable to wait to learn each coaching staff's rotation plans —how many series the starters will play, who will run the offense in the second half—before committing a pick on the winner.

In all cases, the discipline is the same: wait for confirmation of the rotations before making any move . In the preseason, information about who is playing is worth more than any prior analysis.

articles.title: Aaron Rodgers gets ‘attacked’ by Cameron Heyward and Steelers veteran on the sidelines
articles.summary: Veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers is getting ready for his 22nd season in the NFL, and Friday night showed just how much he’s loved and respected as a player during the Pittsburgh Steelers 17-0 loss to the New York Jets.
articles.body:
Veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers is getting ready for his 22nd season in the NFL, and Friday night showed just how much he’s loved and respected as a player during the Pittsburgh Steelers 17-0 loss to the New York Jets.

During the game, veteran leader Cameron Heyward approached Rodgers and started to ‘attack’ him in a friendly way, with some veterans joining in the fun.

Even though the Steelers lost, Pittsburgh is confident that Rodgers can take them far in his last NFL season. Will he deliver? Only time will tell..

articles.title: Aaron Rodgers’ growing confidence has Steelers believing a deep playoff run is within reach
articles.standfirst: The timing, communication, and chemistry with key targets have become a major asset
articles.summary: The timing, communication, and chemistry with key targets have become a major asset
articles.body:
The Pittsburgh Steelers entered last season hoping that Aaron Rodgers could elevate the franchise back into championship contention. One year later, the organization appears even more convinced that goal is attainable.

From the opening days of training camp in Latrobe, Rodgers has looked comfortable, confident, and fully in command of the offense. More importantly, the veteran quarterback appears to be operating on the same wavelength as the pass-catchers around him, a development that has generated optimism throughout the organization as Pittsburgh prepares for the 2026 season.

While every training camp brings its share of encouraging reports, there is a noticeable difference in the way the Steelers are talking about Rodgers this summer. The timing, communication, and chemistry that occasionally took time to develop during his first season in Pittsburgh now appear far more natural. That has been evident in virtually every practice session.

Rodgers has a deep understanding with key targets

Rodgers has continued to work effectively with veteran targets such as DK Metcalf, tight ends Pat Freiermuth and Darnell Washington , and wide receiver Roman Wilson . The familiarity built over the past year has allowed the offense to operate with a greater level of precision, whether the play calls involve quick underneath routes, intermediate throws over the middle, or the deep shots that have long been a hallmark of Rodgers' game.

The progress is particularly important because Rodgers has always been known as a quarterback who demands precision from his receivers. Throughout his NFL career, he has placed a premium on route discipline, pre-snap recognition, and constant communication. Receivers who understand exactly what Rodgers is seeing tend to earn his trust quickly. Those who don't often find themselves learning difficult lessons.

Last season included moments of adjustment as Rodgers and his new teammates learned each other's tendencies. This summer, however, the offense has looked far more synchronized. Michael Pittman Jr. and Germie Bernard are still expected to play meaningful roles within the offense, but the returning connections Rodgers has developed with several of his key targets have been among the most encouraging storylines of camp.

One player drawing particular praise is Roman Wilson

The young receiver has consistently flashed throughout camp and appears to be benefiting from another offseason working alongside the future Hall of Fame quarterback. Steelers assistant general manager Andy Weidl recently highlighted Wilson's development and the growing relationship between him and Rodgers.

Those comments reflect what many observers have noticed throughout camp. Wilson appears more decisive, more comfortable, and more capable of taking advantage of opportunities within the offense. Having Rodgers' trust can significantly accelerate a receiver's growth, and Wilson seems to be reaping the benefits.

The significance extends beyond any one player for the Steelers. The organization believes it has assembled one of the most complete offensive groups Rodgers has worked with in recent years. Metcalf remains one of the league's premier physical receivers. Freiermuth continues to provide reliability in the middle of the field.

Washington offers a unique size mismatch at tight end. Pittman adds another proven weapon, while younger players such as Wilson continue to develop. Combined with Rodgers' experience and football intelligence, the result is an offense that could be considerably more dangerous than the version opponents faced a year ago.

articles.title: Mike McCarthy faces another ordeal at Steelers press conference caused by reporter's cell phone
articles.standfirst: The new Pittsburgh coach found plenty to fix after young quarterbacks struggled against New York
articles.summary: The new Pittsburgh coach found plenty to fix after young quarterbacks struggled against New York
articles.body:
M ike McCarthy ’s frustration was already visible before a ringing phone cut through his postgame press conference.

After watching the Pittsburgh Steelers struggle through a lifeless offensive performance against the New York Jets , the new head coach had little interest in dealing with any additional distractions.

The Steelers were shut out 17-0 at Acrisure Stadium on Friday night, leaving McCarthy with plenty of concerns to address. While explaining where his offense fell short, a reporter’s cell phone interrupted the room, prompting an immediate response from the veteran coach.

“Please, shut that thing off. I mean, my goodness,” McCarthy said.

McCarthy quickly moved on, but the moment captured the mood around Pittsburgh after a night where the offense failed to build on the promise shown in the team’s opening preseason game.

The Steelers had previously impressed in a 28-9 win over the Green Bay Packers , but the performance against New York was a significant step backward.

With Aaron Rodgers and Mason Rudolph rested, Pittsburgh turned to young quarterbacks Will Howard and Drew Allar , but neither was able to consistently challenge the Jets defense.

Howard started the game and completed 10 of 15 passes for 74 yards, but two interceptions in the first half ended promising drives. Allar entered later and finished 11 of 23 for 110 yards while being sacked three times.

“There will definitely be more to clean up this week than last week,” McCarthy said. “That’s the reality of tonight.”

The Steelers ’ offense struggled across the board, finishing with only 98 rushing yards on 26 attempts.

Running back Kaleb Johnson received an extended opportunity, recording 39 yards on 10 carries, but Pittsburgh was unable to establish enough balance to support its young quarterbacks.

McCarthy pointed to missed opportunities in the passing game, including a lack of separation from receivers and an inability to win contested catches.

“We failed to make contested catches,” McCarthy said.

The new Steelers coach believes the difficult outing can still provide value as the team prepares for the regular season.

“We will have great ‘teaching film,’” McCarthy added. “We’re a staff that loves to teach.”

Learning experience for Pittsburgh’s young quarterbacks

The loss provided a reminder that preseason development rarely follows a straight line.

Howard and Allar both showed flashes in previous appearances, but the Jets exposed areas where Pittsburgh’s young quarterbacks still need refinement. Howard acknowledged that the key now is avoiding repeated mistakes.

“The biggest thing is getting to the film and not letting these mistakes fester and not letting one or two mistakes turn into more,” Howard said.

With Rodgers expected to take control of the offense once the regular season begins, the preseason remains focused on evaluating depth and identifying which young players can contribute.

McCarthy ’s staff now has plenty of film to analyze before the Steelers ’ final preseason matchup against the Buffalo Bills .

McCarthy ’s reaction to the phone interruption may have been the most memorable moment of the night, but the real issue facing Pittsburgh is much bigger.

The offense must find consistency before the games start counting. After an impressive opening performance and a frustrating follow-up, McCarthy knows exactly what his team needs next, and that is improvement.
